## Decision problem

What technology decision or repository behavior does this change improve?

## Trade-offs

What new complexity, operational cost, lock-in, or compatibility risk does it introduce?

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_all.py`.
- [ ] I added or updated scenarios when decision guidance changed.
- [ ] I used primary sources for factual technology metadata.
- [ ] I included no credentials, private requirements, or generated local reports.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` when the change is user-visible.
